en: A sepia-toned image of a large, ornate building typical of late 19th or early 20th century German architecture. The building has decorative facades, a steeply sloped tiled roof, and a prominent central tower/spire. In front of the building is a fenced area with trees and bushes. The printed text in red reads 'Niederau. Bez. Dresden.', 'Schule.', and on the left side, vertically, '10350 Brück & Sohn, Meißen'. This is a typical historical school building postcard.
